condition: If you call scan_delta and then filter on a struct column whose Delta file stats cover only some of its fields (for example, a struct that crosses the 32-indexed-column limit), it raises InvalidOperationError because the struct cast fails.
workaround: Stop predicate pushdown by wrapping the predicate in map_batches. Another option is to put the struct column within the first 32 leaf columns, or to raise delta.dataSkippingNumIndexedCols.
